Hi Cara / Ben,

Great to meet you on Friday — thanks again for the time. As promised, I’m sharing a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) starter kit to help accelerate the evaluation and close timeline for BrightLayer Health. The folder has two pieces: a collaborative GDoc (linear MAP template) and a short slide deck you can use to share internally.

High-level notes:
- Goal: 6-week technical evaluation + procurement window (flexible — see milestones below).
- Owners: we suggested owners in the template but want your names on each row.
- Success metrics: latency targets, throughput targets for your sample dataset, and a short quality acceptance checklist.

Attachments: MAP_template_v1.gdoc (editable), MAP_starter_deck_v1.pptx (2-slide executive + 3-slide timeline)
Drive links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB_MAP_template_editable (GDoc), https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1cD_MAP_starter_deck (Slides)

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min working session this week to align stakeholders and lock the 6-week cadence.
2) You assign owners in the GDoc and fill any missing dates.
3) We’ll update the MAP with SOC/infosec checkpoints and a short runbook for pilot validation.

Could you share 2-3 windows for a session this week? We’ll bring a revised slide with milestones after your notes.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai

Thanks, Neha — appreciate the quick turn. We reviewed the starter doc and the overall approach looks good. A couple quick clarifications before we lock a session: 

1) Security checkpoint: our procurement team requires a SOC 2 snapshot and a short list of retention/audit log behaviors before pilot sign-off. Can you add a short "security gates" section in the MAP so we can track who owns evidence delivery?

2) Pilot dataset: we'll run a 48-hour throughput test with a 10k-record sample. Can you add expected token/latency budgets per request for that run so our infra team can provision?

3) Timeline: 6 weeks sounds reasonable, but procurement might push approvals to week 8. Could we map an 8-week alternate timeline (A/B) in the plan so we have a clear escalation path?

We’re available Wed 20 May 2:00–3:30pm PT or Thu 21 May 9:00–10:00am PT for a working session.

On the MAP itself: I added comments in the GDoc for the success metrics section and left a placeholder for SOC 2 evidence.

—Cara
